name: api-vault
description: Research and securely configure APIs, databases, MCP servers, scripts, and other project connections.

interface.longDescription: API Vault researches official authentication documentation, identifies required connection fields, builds or updates a secure website Connections page, offers provider-side IP allowlisting guidance, and configures local environment files for APIs, databases, MCP servers, Python scripts, SSH, OAuth, webhooks, and custom services.
defaultPrompt: Securely configure an API for this project.
Build a secure Connections page for this website.
Add a PostgreSQL, MCP, or Python connection.
